UNANG MRT EXPERIENCE NI DRA. BELO 🚆

Ibinahagi ni celebrity dermatologist Dra. Vicki Belo ang kanyang first-ever MRT experience matapos maipit sa matinding traffic papunta sa concert ng OPM singer Morissette Amon.

"First time to ride the MRT! Mas mabilis nga ang MRT compared to a Ferrari in Metro Manila!!!!!! Made it to @itsmorissette to see her shine ✨🌟🌟🌟🌟," saad nito sa kanyang Instagram account.
